fieldNotes.truckGate: All three driveways (2 off 12th Ave S, 1 off Cliff Rd E between the plant and the flex building to its east) are open curb cuts - Street View 2022/2023 shows no barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint at any of them.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at any entrance in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Plant's own docks are on the EAST face (box trucks/trailers backed in, est ~14 doors); the big ~25-28-door dock row visible in the shared truck court belongs to the separate Pepsi warehouse at 11601 12th Ave S immediately north and was NOT counted.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Set true because the plant shares one open truck court with the adjacent Pepsi warehouse (11601 12th Ave S) - operationally a two-building Pepsi campus even though the roster lists them as separate facilities; trucks for both intermix in the same yard.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer rows: parallel-parked row along the plant's north wall (~8), strip along 12th Ave fence (~10, Pepsi-branded trailers in Street View), plus trailers staged along the east drive.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Ample paved yard staging north of the plant, but with no gate the pre/post-gate distinction does not apply; marked false.
